source: User ran pm_footprint/local_v13_wht_sample.py locally against mounted F444W_psf_matched_F444W_WHT_v13.fits; user uploaded its JSON/CSV/NPZ.

cell_phase_qc.interpretation: The near-canceling total-area difference does not imply perfect edge alignment. Two phases are not an uncertainty interval.

comparison.note: Different resolutions, grid deposition losses (~0.96% per tile in earlier COSMOS-Web run) and reductions mean these differences are not a measured true area discrepancy.

limits: v13 WHT>0 is geometrical sampled area not empirically calibrated F444W 26.2 AB dropout effective area.
Source-center WHT positive is not equivalent to unmasked or isolated PSF/aperture.
Both confirmed movers having high WHT is descriptive, not proof of causal PM sensitivity bias.
Second-epoch F356W depth and positions not available in the uploaded files.
User-supplied JWST star-mask archive was processed previously and is NOT required again; exact mask-v13-WHT sky intersection still outstanding.
Two phase shifts with 3.6-arcsec sample spacing do not establish sub-percent area precision.
v13 epoch and archive intersections need spatial overlay, not ratios from unmatched area totals.
